hero.description: A closer look at how careful translation, contextual understanding, and linguistic precision turn a message from simply translated into naturally understood.

stats.title: Precision in Every Detail
stats.description: A professional approach shaped by accuracy, context, clarity, and consistency.

beforeAfter.title: Where Translation Becomes Meaning
beforeAfter.description: Good translation goes beyond replacing words. It considers tone, context, audience, and purpose to create language that feels natural without losing the original message.

examples.original: Our product is simply the best in the market.
examples.arabic: منتجنا يقدّم مستوى من الجودة والتميز يضعه في صدارة السوق.
examples.context: The wording moves beyond a literal claim and creates a more natural, confident expression for an Arabic-speaking audience.

examples.original: The parties shall resolve any disputes through mediation.
examples.arabic: يلتزم الطرفان بتسوية أي نزاعات عن طريق الوساطة.
examples.context: The translation uses clear contractual language while preserving the obligatory meaning of the original clause.

security.description: Translation work often involves private documents and sensitive information. Every project is approached with discretion, responsible document handling, and respect for client confidentiality.

features.title: Confidential Handling
features.description: Sensitive documents are treated with discretion throughout the translation process.

features.title: Professional Privacy
features.description: Client information and project content are handled responsibly and are not used as public work without permission.

viewer.title: Confidential Project
viewer.description: Private project materials remain protected and are not displayed publicly without client permission.
